School.title: School
School.description: Represents a tenant in the multi-tenant SaaS application, corresponding to an educational institution.

id.description: Unique identifier for the School entity.

name.description: The official name of the school or institution.

logoUrl.description: URL to the school's logo, displayed in their portal.

customDomain.description: Optional custom domain for the school's dedicated portal access.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the school record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the school record was last updated.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account within the system, belonging to a specific school and having a designated role.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this user belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N User)

email.description: The user's email address, used for login and notifications.

role.description: The role of the user within the system (e.g., 'Applicant', 'Admin', 'Reviewer').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

ApplicantProfile.title: ApplicantProfile
ApplicantProfile.description: Stores specific profile information for an applicant, linked to their user account.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ApplicantProfile entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User account associated with this applicant profile. (Relationship: User 1:1 ApplicantProfile)

schoolId.description: Reference to the School the applicant belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N ApplicantProfile)

highSchoolName.description: The name of the applicant's high school.

graduationYear.description: The year the applicant is expected to graduate or has graduated from high school.

addressLine1.description: The first line of the applicant's mailing address.

addressLine2.description: The second line of the applicant's mailing address (optional).

city.description: The city of the applicant's mailing address.

state.description: The state or province of the applicant's mailing address.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the applicant's mailing address.

country.description: The country of the applicant's mailing address.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the applicant profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the applicant profile was last updated.

Scholarship.title: Scholarship
Scholarship.description: Defines a scholarship opportunity offered by a school, including its details and criteria.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Scholarship entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School offering this scholarship. (Relationship: School 1:N Scholarship)

title.description: The name or title of the scholarship.

description.description: A detailed description of the scholarship, its purpose, and what it entails.

awardAmount.description: The financial amount awarded to the scholarship recipient.

applicationDeadline.description: The deadline by which applications for this scholarship must be submitted.

eligibilityCriteria.description: Textual description of the criteria applicants must meet to be eligible for the scholarship.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the scholarship record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the scholarship record was last updated.

Application.title: Application
Application.description: Represents an applicant's submission for a specific scholarship opportunity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Application entity.

applicantId.description: Reference to the ApplicantProfile submitting this application. (Relationship: ApplicantProfile 1:N Application)

scholarshipId.description: Reference to the Scholarship this application is for. (Relationship: Scholarship 1:N Application)

schoolId.description: Reference to the School the application belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N Application)

status.description: The current status of the application (e.g., 'Draft', 'Submitted', 'Under Review', 'Awarded', 'Rejected').

submissionDate.description: The date and time the application was officially submitted by the applicant.

finalScore.description: The final aggregated score for the application, typically calculated from reviewer scores.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the application record was created (e.g., when an applicant started drafting).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the application record was last updated.

ApplicationFile.title: ApplicationFile
ApplicationFile.description: Stores metadata about files uploaded by applicants as part of their scholarship application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ApplicationFile entity.

applicationId.description: Reference to the Application this file is associated with. (Relationship: Application 1:N ApplicationFile)

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this application file belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N ApplicationFile)

fileType.description: The category or type of the uploaded file (e.g., 'Transcript', 'Resume', 'Essay', 'RecommendationLetter').

fileName.description: The original name of the uploaded file.

fileUrl.description: A secure URL where the uploaded file can be accessed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the file metadata was last updated.

ScholarshipQuestion.title: ScholarshipQuestion
ScholarshipQuestion.description: Defines a question that is part of a scholarship application form, including its type and conditional logic.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ScholarshipQuestion entity.

scholarshipId.description: Reference to the Scholarship this question belongs to. (Relationship: Scholarship 1:N ScholarshipQuestion)

questionText.description: The actual text of the question presented to the applicant.

questionType.description: The expected input type for the answer (e.g., 'text', 'textarea', 'number', 'date', 'select', 'multiselect', 'file').

options.description: An array of possible options for 'select' or 'multiselect' question types.

conditionalOnQuestionId.description: Reference to another ScholarshipQuestion whose answer dictates the visibility of this question. (Relationship: ScholarshipQuestion 1:N ScholarshipQuestion (self-referencing))

conditionalValue.description: The specific value of the `conditionalOnQuestionId`'s answer that makes this question visible.

order.description: The display order of the question within the scholarship application form.

isRequired.description: Indicates whether the applicant is required to answer this question.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the question was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the question was last updated.

ApplicationAnswer.title: ApplicationAnswer
ApplicationAnswer.description: Records an applicant's answer to a specific question for a particular scholarship application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ApplicationAnswer entity.

applicationId.description: Reference to the Application this answer belongs to. (Relationship: Application 1:N ApplicationAnswer)

scholarshipQuestionId.description: Reference to the ScholarshipQuestion this answer is for. (Relationship: ScholarshipQuestion 1:N ApplicationAnswer)

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this application answer belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N ApplicationAnswer)

answerValue.description: The applicant's response to the question. For file types, this would store the ApplicationFile ID.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the answer was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the answer was last updated.

ReviewerAssignment.title: ReviewerAssignment
ReviewerAssignment.description: Manages the assignment of an application to a specific reviewer for evaluation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ReviewerAssignment entity.

reviewerId.description: Reference to the User (reviewer role) assigned to review the application. (Relationship: User 1:N ReviewerAssignment)

applicationId.description: Reference to the Application assigned for review. (Relationship: Application 1:N ReviewerAssignment)

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this reviewer assignment belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N ReviewerAssignment)

assignedDate.description: The date and time the application was assigned to the reviewer.

status.description: The current status of the review assignment (e.g., 'Pending', 'In Progress', 'Completed', 'Cancelled').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the reviewer assignment was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the reviewer assignment was last updated.

ApplicationReview.title: ApplicationReview
ApplicationReview.description: Stores the comments and scores provided by a reviewer for a specific application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ApplicationReview entity.

reviewerAssignmentId.description: Reference to the ReviewerAssignment that this review is part of. (Relationship: ReviewerAssignment 1:1 ApplicationReview)

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this application review belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N ApplicationReview)

score.description: The numerical score given by the reviewer for the application.

comments.description: Textual comments or feedback provided by the reviewer.

submittedDate.description: The date and time when the reviewer submitted their review.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the application review was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the application review was last updated.

firestore.reasoning:
This multi-tenant SaaS application, 'ScholarShip', is designed with a strong emphasis on tenant isolation, with each school representing a distinct tenant. The core principle driving this Firestore structure is **Authorization Independence**, ensuring that security rules are simple, robust, and easily debuggable by avoiding `get()` calls.

To achieve this, the `schoolId` is the primary authorization context and is **denormalized into every single document** related to application data (e.g., User, ApplicantProfile, Scholarship, Application, ApplicationFile, ScholarshipQuestion, ApplicationAnswer, ReviewerAssignment, ApplicationReview). This means that for any data document, its belonging `schoolId` can be directly accessed from `resource.data.schoolId` without needing to traverse parent documents. This denormalization strategy is critical for eliminating hierarchical authorization dependencies.

**Structural Segregation** is implemented by making `/schools/{schoolId}` the root for all school-specific data. All subcollections under a `schoolId` inherit its tenant context, ensuring a homogeneous security posture where all documents within a given school's subtree implicitly belong to that school and are subject to its access rules. This significantly simplifies security rules, as access checks always involve comparing the authenticated user's `schoolId` (obtained from their `/users/{userId}` document) with the `schoolId` in the document's path and its `resource.data.schoolId` field.

**Query as a Security Principal (QAPs)** is fully supported due to this design. Since `schoolId` is denormalized into every document and is present in the document path, `list` operations (queries) can be secured effectively. For example, a user authenticated with `request.auth.uid` can have their `schoolId` resolved from their `/users/{userId}` document. Then, all queries performed will target paths like `/schools/{request.auth.token.schoolId}/...`. The security rules will enforce that the `schoolId` in the path matches the user's `schoolId` and also matches the `schoolId` stored in `resource.data` for every document retrieved. This prevents users from querying or accessing data outside their authorized school, making rule writing straightforward (e.g., `allow read: if request.auth.token.schoolId == schoolId && resource.data.schoolId == schoolId;`).

Additionally, **Hierarchical Paths for User-Owned Data** are used, such as `/schools/{schoolId}/applicantProfiles/{applicantProfileId}`, where `applicantProfileId` documents also contain `userId`. This allows an applicant to manage their own profile and applications (`resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid`), while still being constrained by the tenant's `schoolId`.

Explicit state modeling (e.g., `status` fields) and consistent naming (`schoolId`, `userId`, descriptive wildcards like `{scholarshipId}`) further enhance debuggability and predictability. Roles are stored directly in the `User` document, adhering to the **DBAC** principle without custom claims.
